title: Developer Hub » Robots File
content:
## Developer Hub » Robots File


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000075850

To edit the default version of the Robots.txt file navigate to Developer Hub >> Robots File :


## Default Rules


The default file includes the following rules.

User-agent: Googlebot
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: Mediapartners-Google
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /
    
User-agent: Yahoo-MMCrawler
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: Yahoo-slurp
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: slurp
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /
    
User-agent: Msnbot
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: MSNBot-media
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /

User-agent: Bing Preview bot
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /
    
User-agent: Twitterbot
Disallow: /api/
Allow: /
    
User-agent: *
Disallow: /

To add to the file, click inside the text field and add the necessary rules.

See How To Add Bots To Your Robots.Txt File (Ahrefs Example) .
